title: Dark Chocolate Fudge Brownies
description: Rich, fudgy brownies with a deep dark chocolate flavor.
instructions: Butter an 8-inch square baking pan and line it with parchment paper.
Melt dark chocolate and butter in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Whisk in sugar until well combined.
Beat in eggs one at a time.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
Add dry ingredients to chocolate mixture and stir until just combined.
Pour batter into prepared baking pan and smooth top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out with a few moist crumbs.
Let cool completely in pan before cutting into squares.
